mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies with temperatures around 72 degrees by Reddan Soccer Park, a waning crescent moon, and an air quality index of 51. The overnight low will reach 65 degrees, and please prepare for some rain overnight.

The City of Verona continues to maintain its infrastructure by contracting with AECOM Inc. for engineering services. These engineering reports are regularly presented to the City Council, ensuring transparency and accountability for all city projects.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Square or catch some tunes at Paddy Mac's.
Looking at the weekly report, on July 31, a driver was stopped for equipment violations and was subsequently arrested for an O W I and cited for related traffic offences.

Today's flavor is the fan-favorite Really Reese's. If you want to grab a bowl or cone, get moving quickly because they are closing in less than an hour. If you miss them tonight, they will be back with the Andes Mint Avalanche tomorrow.
